scene-welcome.en: This is a small notes app. Nothing fancy: a list, a search box and a button. Let us record a demo of it.

scene-search.en: Typing in the search box filters the list as you go. Two letters are enough to find the report.

scene-new-note.en: A new note takes a title, a line of text and a tag. Save it and it lands at the top of the list.

scene-done.en: Marking a note as done crosses it out and moves it to the Done view, where it can be brought back.

scene-views.en: The views on the left filter by tag. Work shows only what is pending for work; Home does the same for home.

scene-closing.en: That is the whole tour. Every scene you just saw was a function, and every cut was made from the marks it wrote.
